name: creative-imagemasking
title: Creative Image Masking
blurb: Image masked to a complex geometric cutout shape.
description: Renders an image clipped to a complex geometric SVG mask embedded as a data URI. Includes hover scale animation.
use_when: Hero images, featured content, or statement layouts with distinctive shapes.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical edges (clipping hides content); browsers lacking mask-image.
a11y: Static image with alt text. Mask is decorative.
